$comment: Single source of truth for what rxova.org is assembled from. Adding a project is ONE entry
here plus a matching entry in @rxova/brand's PROJECTS (which the docs sites need for the
project switcher). Nothing in .github/workflows changes: deploy.yml and ingest.yml both read
Paths are DERIVED from `id` by scripts/registry.mjs and must not be written here:
id: "foo"  ->  base /packages/foo/ · mount packages/foo · artifact docs-foo
->  persisted docs at release content-foo, asset docs-foo.tgz
`enabled` gates the project everywhere at once — its ingest is accepted, it is mounted, and
the landing shows its Docs link. It lives in git rather than a repo variable so the site's
contents are reviewable in a PR and visible in `git log`, not invisible state in repo settings.
There is deliberately no `build`, `install` or `output` here. The aggregator never checks a
project out and never runs its toolchain: docs are built by their own repos and sent here
already built (see docs/INPUTS-CONTRACT.md), validated and persisted by ingest.yml, and
fetched back at deploy time by scripts/fetch-docs.mjs. A source entry only says which project
exists, whether it is on, and how it is described on the landing.
`repo` defaults to rxova/<id> — the repo whose CI ingests this project's docs. Set it only
for a project that does not live at that path.

landing.blurb: Model multi-step, branching flows as a graph instead of a tangle of booleans and effects. Core is framework-agnostic; React bindings and a Chrome DevTools bridge come in the box.
A family of focused input components — localized currency, OTP slots, and feedback stars — each zero-to-few dependencies, accessible, and free of the usual cursor and locale bugs.
Share state and messages across every tab, window, and worker — a framework-agnostic core plus React bindings, one small API.
